reason: A DSH task-management plugin centered on planning and executing requirements through a kanban board, queued and scheduled child-agent runs, progress control, workspace persistence, and an acceptance/rework loop.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 会话中提供六列任务看板，用于管理需求、排队和调度子代理执行、跟踪进度并完成验收返工闭环。
summaries.en: A DSH session task board for managing requirements, queueing and scheduling child-agent execution, tracking progress, and handling acceptance and rework.

capabilities: Provides a six-column task board for requirements, execution, pausing, acceptance, and completion
Queues and schedules tasks for serial execution in child agent sessions
Allows pausing, stopping, resuming, and reworking queued executions
Persists task state in a workspace directory and communicates through a host-client RPC route
